{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has faced antitrust lawsuits and regulatory scrutiny.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Epic Games's Sweeney stated that the decision \"isn't a win for developers or for consumers\", that Epic would not be bringing *Fortnite* back to iOS until \"Epic can offer in-app payment in fair competition with Apple in-app payment, passing along the savings to consumers\", and that they would continue to litigate on this matter."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in legal disputes with Apple over App Store policies.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Epic filed notice of its appeal to the [Ninth Circuit] on September 12, 2021, challenging Judge Rogers's conclusion that Apple was not a monopoly."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been accused of violating contractual terms with Apple.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Rogers stated that Epic did violate its contractual terms as a developer with Apple in how they deployed the update to *Fortnite* in August 2020 that instigated events, such that Apple may block Epic in the future from providing apps to the App Store."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been fined or ordered to pay damages in a legal case with Apple.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Rogers ruled against Epic, requiring them to pay Apple $3.6 million, 30% of the revenue that was withheld to Apple related to their attempts to bypass the App Store."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in regulatory actions related to antitrust enforcement.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "A coalition of 35 states, Microsoft, the [Electronic Frontier Foundation], and several other groups filed amicus briefs in support of Epic's position, arguing that Apple held a monopoly and thus that Epic should prevail in its lawsuit."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in multiple appeals and Supreme Court cases with Apple.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Both Apple and Epic Games appealed this decision to the Supreme Court."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been accused of malicious compliance with regulatory changes.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Sweeney still argued that the new terms for use in the EU were \"a new instance of [Malicious Compliance]\" and would continue to challenge those through legal routes."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court found willful non-compliance with an injunction.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Rogers ruled in April 2025 that Apple \"willfully\" failed to comply with her previous injunctions, and further extended these injunctions to prevent Apple from collecting any fees from third-party storefronts."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered the removal of fees on third-party payment systems.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Rogers also referred the case to the federal attorney's office for possible criminal contempt proceedings, finding that company executives had lied and knowingly took an anti-competitive route to try to demonstrate compliance."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Apple allowed developers to include \"metadata buttons, external links, or other calls to action that direct customers to purchasing mechanisms\", but required that developers give Apple 27% of all sales made within seven days of being directed to these sites."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to stop collecting fees from third-party storefronts.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Rogers ruled that Apple willfully failed to comply with her previous injunctions, and further extended these injunctions to prevent Apple from collecting any fees from third-party storefronts."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Rogers also referred the case to the federal attorney's office for possible criminal contempt proceedings, finding that company executives had lied and knowingly took an anti-competitive route to try to demonstrate compliance."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Apple described as a \"reasonable means to account for the substantial value Apple provides developers, including in facilitating linked transactions\"."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The App Store posts a warning screen stating that Apple is not responsible for any security or privacy issues related to third-party payment systems when clicking through to one of these systems."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Apple ultimately approved of Epic's application to be on the App Store in July 2024, following Apple's complaints that Epic's apps used user interface aspects that were too similar to its own storefront elements."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The Epic Games Store app, along with *Fortnite*, were released for iOS users in Europe only on August 16, 2024."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The United Kingdom passed the [Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Bill] in May 2024, which made similar requirements on app stores as the EU's DMA."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "After its passage, Epic Games stated they plan to bring their own Epic Games Store and *Fortnite* to iOS systems in the UK in the second half of 2025."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Companies like [Facebook], [Spotify], and the [Match Group] supported Epic Games in its lawsuit and spoke of their own past issues with Apple's App Store policies related to their services."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D533]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "The developer has been involved in a case where a court ordered Apple to allow external payment links without restrictions.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Digital Content Next, a non-profit trade group representing media outlets like *[The New York Times]* and *[The Wall Street Journal]*, also backed Epic's suit, asserting among other issues that Apple has given out uniquely favorable deals to some providers like [Amazon] but not to others."
    }
  ]
}
